units.source_text: 但是这些杜子春都毫无察觉，他只是靠在城门的墙壁上，呆呆的望着天空。

en.t: But Du Zichun noticed none of this; he only leaned against the city gate wall and stared blankly up at the sky.

units.source_text: 天空中云霞渐渐的消失了，一弯新月爬上天空，就像指甲的抓痕一样白。

en.t: The clouds and rosy haze in the sky gradually vanished, and a slender new moon climbed into the sky, white like a scratch from a fingernail.
